scopeNote: This package implements NO second-protocol Driver. E owns the pilot cases/scoring and calls the E grant; B only provides verifiable run capability and reconciles the original control grant.

grants.why: The ledger file the grant names has never existed in this branch's history (git log --all on that path is empty). wave03-status.json declares used=0 while pointing at that absent file, and budget.mjs grantView() answers used:0/remaining:4 from an empty fallback ledger. That is a status-document inference, not a reconciled remainder, so capacity is NOT treated as available and any real send is blocked until the ledger is reconstructed from real begin/attempt evidence.
